mapper.select: SELECT status,deleted FROM article_info WHERE article_id=#{articleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE article_view_sync SET attempts=LEAST(attempts+1,30),last_error=#{error},lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL, available_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{seconds},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND lease_token=#{token}
UPDATE article_view_sync SET attempts=0,last_error=NULL,lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL, available_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND lease_token=#{token}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM article_view_sync WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND lease_token=#{token} AND target_count<=#{count}
mapper.select: SELECT article_id,target_count,attempts FROM article_view_sync WHERE available_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY available_at,article_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_view_sync(article_id,target_count,available_at) VALUES (#{articleId},#{targetCount},TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,2,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_count=GREATEST(target_count,VALUES(target_count)),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
